notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.1.910 Released - Security Update
notes.content:
2025-09-19 - Released Version 1.1.1.910 - Security Update
[list]
[*]Updated the LibreHardwareMonitorLib dependency to remove use of the WinRing0 driver. According to CVE-2020-14979, the driver is vulnerable to privilege escalation attack, meaning that if a user were to download and run malicious software, that software could exploit a running instance of the WinRing0 driver as a method to gain administrator rights without asking the user through a User Account Control prompt.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.1.886 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Made adjustments to how window opacity and click through state are changed to hopefully make it more reliable in different environments.[/*][*]New options are now available for Click Through Overlay and Ghost Window functionality. By default, windows will become temporarily clickable while focused. Once you switch to a different application, click-through functionality will be restored. This allows you to easily make adjustments to your click through overlays without having to toggle them off and on manually. To focus on the unclickable window, you can use the task bar, task ring, task menu, or alt tab. Additionally, you can still select the old functionality of the window never being clickable or make it so that it loses its transparency while its clickable.[/*][*]Fixed some issues with window targeting where some invisible windows would become the target of actions. This primarily effected the drag click features of many tools, such as Borderless Fullscreen and Click Through Overlay, where you hold the orb button with the left mouse click and then right click on the desired window. This does not effect focused window targeting, which is when you simply press the orb button and it targets the currently focused window.[/*][*]Fixed a bug in Glass Apps that would cause it to perform unnecessary calculations when not enabled.[/*][*]Added a content font setting in the style menu. For now, this field will require manually entering the exact name of the font family desired.[/*][*]Added more color style options for orb buttons. Some of the color settings do not have live preview enabled, so you may need to open a new flyout window to see your changes.[/*][*]Adjusted the behavior of "Flyout Auto Remove Topmost" to activate when the majority of a newly focused window is covered by a Simplode flyout window so that it will not cover the newly focused window. I am still unsure what the best strategy for it should be, so feedback would be nice.[/*][*]Added the "Legacy" window flyout option. This will cause all Simplode flyout overlay windows to have their style overridden to that of a standard window with no animations or transparency, resulting in increased application efficiency and a more classic application appearance. The option itself is available under "Customize Style"->"Flyout Mode" and can also be triggered by the new "Legacy" performance preset in the "Welcome" screen.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Released Version 1.1.1.817
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a race condition issue that could cause Chill Boost to crash.[/*][*]Updated Chill Boost to improve support for newer processors.[/*][*]Changed Chill Boost Efficiency Locker Mode default to Performance. This should be a better default setting for people first trying Chill Boost, as it still improves efficiency of heavy background tasks without negatively impacting foreground performance most of the time. Users who desire greater energy efficiency should still try the Efficiency Optimized mode.[/*][*]Adjusted Efficiency Locker to be automatically deactivated when another user is in an interactive session. This effects when Simplode Suite is still running under one user but the interactive session is now operating under another user. In this case, thermal and load limits will remain active. If the other user's session has Chill Boost activated, it will take over power control. This fixes a problem where performance can be unintentionally reduced when switching to another user, but retains full efficiency benefits of the efficiency locker if your PC is in the lock screen.[/*][*]Fixed bug in error logging code which can cause the application to become unable to launch.[/*][*]Fixed bug that could state desynchronization between separate processes within the application.[/*][*]Removed some notifications regarding product registration for Steam users. These messages have been causing confusion, as it was not immediately clear that the registration was optional and left users wondering if their Steam purchase was properly recognized. Steam users should only need to register if they want the ability to reliably run Simplode Suite's tools while Steam is not running.[/*][*]Upgraded application to .NET Framework 4.8, which should result in minor performance and efficiency increases throughout the application. This change was required to update dependencies needed for modernizing Chill Boost.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Released Version 1.1.1.719
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Included a DPI fix for older operating system versions.[/*][*]Fixed an issue that could cause the tool to become unresponsive after a rendering failure.[/*][*]Fixed an issue when using the tool to launch other programs, they would not have a working directory causing some programs to fail.[/*][*]Made improvements to window detection to make it more reliable and up to date, helping the tiling window manager and other features that target application windows to work more reliably.[/*][*]Added "(Language)" to the label for the language selector, in case you change the language and can no longer find the language option.[/*][*]Added a webcam settings editor utility in beta.[/*][*]Fixed issue when uninstalling the Steam edition of the product with auto start enabled, a useless task scheduler entry would remain post installation.[/*][*]For the local documentation generation, fixed the super ring map animations.[/*][*]Added video references to the local documentation. The videos are still hosted remotely, but now they can be viewed within the local documentation.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.1.652 Released
notes.content:
2022-10-15 - Released Version 1.1.1.652
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with Virtual Touchscreen which would cause it to render incorrectly the first time it is launched after a device restart.[/*][*]Improved ability for Chill Boost Efficiency Locker to determine focus of related processes.[/*][*]Adjusted default settings of Chill Boost to make them more suitable for all devices.[/*][*]In the Settings Optimizer, added the Disable Search Box Suggestions toggle.  This is a new way to disable web search in the Windows 11 start menu.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.1.612 Released
notes.content:
2022-02-15 - Released Version 1.1.1.612
[list]
[*]Added option for Smart Focus to only impact newly opened windows.[/*][*]Fixed issue where the image preview box would fail when attempting to produce a file with a long name.  The image preview box can now produce Unicode file names and will automatically shorten names that are too long.[/*][*]Fixed issue where Microphone Manager would fail when adding or removing an audio device.[/*][*]Updated Smart Focus to recognize newer naming scheme for start menu windows.[/*][*]Fixed bug in Smart Focus where full screen and old windows options were making the task switcher and start menu options ineffective.[/*][*]Added right click context menu to settings headers with an option to revert to default.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with Loudness Manager and Microphone Manager which caused them to act on new or reconnected devices of the wrong type.[/*][*]Disabled mouse wheel zooming by default.  This feature was found to be disruptive when accidentally triggered by users who are unaware of the feature.  It was also removed from the polite preset.[/*][*]Due to new users being overwhelmed by the sheer number of features available in Simplode Suite, the automatic free trial has been removed.  Three free trial periods are still available and can be found quickly in the welcome screen.[/*][*]Window hover linking is now disabled by default to avoid bothering new users who do not want to use the feature.  It will be automatically enabled in the Normal and Wild preset modes.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.1.523 Released
notes.content:
2021-09-01 - Released Version 1.1.1.523
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where some drop down lists would incorrectly show ID numbers instead of meaningful names.[/*][*]Added the Mouse Lock feature, which lets you lock the cursor down to a specific window or in some cases unlock the cursor from a window which locked it.[/*][*]Keyboard Dynamic Repeat and Repeat Next Key now attempts to also match the portion of time which you were pressing the button.[/*][*]Added Screen Stream Guard as an experimental beta feature.  Screen Stream Guard protects unwanted windows from appearing on screen.[/*][*]Improved efficiency of the Microphone Manager.[/*][*]Reduced input lag in some cases where keyboard hooks were unnecessarily activated.[/*][*]Adjusted inter-process communication code to possibly solve a rare performance issue.[/*][*]Microphone Manager, Loudness Manager, Chill Boost, and Input process default priorities have been lowered from Real Time to High.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.1.446 Released
notes.content:
2021-05-31 - Released Version 1.1.1.446
[list]
[*]System audio volume synchronization is once again enabled by default.  The feature has been optimized so that it will not activate until you open a volume panel within the tool.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Loudness Manager could cause the entire tool to crash when audio devices are inaccessible.[/*][*]In the Chill Boost historical data panel, the Estimated Kilowatt Hours edits were not being saved, but it now it is no longer marked editable.[/*][*]A product validation issue has been fixed (outdated SSL certificate).[/*][*]Fixed an issue with Fake Focus where the state would be lost in certain situations.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.1.429 Released
notes.content:
2021-03-01 - Released Version 1.1.1.429
[list]
[*]When using the Caps Lock Overload feature, it is now possible to turn caps lock on (the original function of caps lock) by double pressing the caps lock button.  This behavior can be turned off with the Caps Lock Overload Double Press option.[/*][*]Added an option to enable system audio volume synchronization with Simplode Suite.  This feature was previously on by default, but it has been reported to cause problems on some devices, so it is now available as an option and is disabled by default.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.1.389 Released
notes.content:
2021-02-02 - Released Version 1.1.1.389
[list]
[*]To avoid confusion, the Free Trial segment of the Welcome screen is now hidden if you have unlocked every package.[/*][*]Reduced memory usage of the menu ring by loading each ring on demand.  If the memory management strategy is set to Maximum Performance, the ring will be preloaded as before.[/*][*]Reduced memory usage when the menu ring is closed.  If the memory management strategy is set to Maximum Performance, the ring will remain in memory for faster access.[/*][*]It is now possible to open multiple separate ring menus simultaneously.  It can be accessed in the (...) menu of the flyout for a menu under (🔾*) New Ring Menu, which will launch that menu as a new ring.[/*][*]Fixed an error that could occur when exiting the application.[/*][*]Fixed issue with weather tray icons not being visible if more color icons are turned off.[/*][*]Fixed issue when attempting to open Simplode Suite when Simplode Suite is already open. The cancel button now properly closes the new launch attempt.[/*][*]Slightly optimized glow effects by removing unused code.[/*][*]Fixed issue where reloading icons could cause the tool to go become temporarily unresponsive and use excessive amounts of memory.[/*][*]Changing the glow icon intensity setting or glow icon effect enabled setting will now reload all icons.[/*][*]Added the Caps Lock Overload feature.  If enabled, the caps lock key is overloaded.  Holding the caps lock key will activate both the Windows key and the control key.  This can give you quicker access to more hotkey choices in most applications that support custom hotkeys.  This will also block caps lock from being enabled.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.1.320 Released
notes.content:
2021-1-2 - Released Version 1.1.1.320
[list][*]Mouse display no longer shows in taskbar.[/*][*]Added task bar tasks.  When right clicking on the Simplode Suite task bar entry, you can now easily access the Ring Menu Settings, the Ring in Taskbar option, the Main Menu, and the Action Search.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with the Toggle Ring Menu hotkey management not working in certain situations.[/*][*]Fixed an exception in the Hidden Actions feature.[/*][*]Fixed a rare exception during application startup.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with the translation engine attempting to translate already translated text.[/*][*]Fixed some missing translations throughout the application.[/*][*]Added a basic hotkey manager to see all of the tool's hotkeys in one screen.[/*][*]Removed the default hotkey for Restart Explorer.[/*][*]Removed the default hotkey for Sleep.[/*][*]Changed the default hotkey for Toggle Ring Menu to [Win]+[Shift]+[Tab] to avoid conflicts with web browsers.[/*][*]Added more options to the Screen Off feature: 
  Blackout Mode: The screen off feature will keep turning the screen off until you hit a key or click with the mouse.  Additionally, it will black out the entire screen.   This helps in case your mouse erroneously wakes up the screens.
  Lock Screen: This is the same as Blackout Mode, except when the screen is restored the lock screen will be activated.  This is less secure than immediately activating the lock screen, but the lock screen is more of a casual deterrence measure anyways if an adversary has physical access to your machine.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.1.212 Released
notes.content:
2020-12-18 - Released Version 1.1.1.212
[list][*]Fixed an issue with some windows not closing correctly.  This impacts the screenshot tool when cursor is captured and also the Red Cyan 3d Desktop feature.[/*][*]Fixed a memory leak caused by sharing of cache objects.[/*][*]Fixed a memory leak caused by sharing of font data.[/*][*]Fixed a memory leak caused by sharing of unfrozen brushes.[/*][*]Improved performance and memory consumption for tray icons.[/*][*]Improved efficiency and memory consumption of databinding.[/*][*]Added Hidden Actions.  With hidden actions, you can hide features of Simplode Suite from the Ring Menu.  This can be done by right clicking on the Toggle Favorite (★) button and changing the Ring Menu Hidden checkbox.[/*][*]Added Memory Management Strategy option to the Limit Simplode Suite Ram Usage feature.  By default, it is set to Balanced, which will try to keep memory usage of the tool low without sacrificing much performance.[/*][*]The glow effect cache will now clear when all windows are closed so long as the Memory Management Strategy is not set to Maximize Performance.[/*][*]Fixed Super Ring Type not showing its values correctly.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.1.113 Released
notes.content:
2020-12-11 - Released Version 1.1.1.113
[list]

[*]Fixed a memory leak caused by a shared memory pointer not being released in the inter-process communications.

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.0.363 Released
notes.content:
10/15/2020 - Released Version 1.1.0.363

[list]
[*]Fixed issue with flyout windows remaining attached to the menu ring even after the menu ring moves away.  This would cause flyout windows to unintuitively show and hide along with the menu ring.[/*][*]Added the ability to add an entire directory structure to the favorites ring when dropping a folder on to the ring menu.  By default, further changes to the directory structure will be mirrored in the ring system.  Inside the flyout window for the newly created ring is an option to toggle the automatic updates.  Thanks to merfab76 for requesting this feature![*]Added additional information when executables are added to the favorites ring.  The version, product name, and description are extracted from the executable and included in the description of the new menu item, which also allows this information to be indexed in the Action Search feature.[/*][*]Added an option to make the Favorites ring the default ring that is shown when using the Toggle Ring Menu feature.  While you can already directly open the Favorites menu using a custom hotkey, this option will cause some of the more advanced features like the mouse button combos to open the Favorites menu.[/*][*]Toggling a menu ring with a hotkey now behaves more intuitively.  If it closes the ring and there is not a previous ring to show, it will hide the ring menu.  It will also cause the ring to jump to your cursor only when opening and not when closing.[/*][*]Fixed issue where the Simplode Protocol registry keys were not removed when uninstalling the Steam version of Simplode Suite.[/*][*]Fixed issue where the Weather tool will keep popping up additional windows each time you click on the flyout button.[/*][*]Fixed issue where disabling the Steam integration would not immediately end the Steam integration.[/*][*]Added a Polite mode to help new users avoid certain features that can be a bit tricky to find and disable if the user finds them annoying.  Glass Apps and Cursor Finder are disabled in the Polite preset.[/*][*]Added achievements for using Glass Apps and Cursor Finder.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.0.265 Released
notes.content:
10/1/2020 - Released Version 1.1.0.265

[list][*]Improved efficiency of Glass Apps Video Auto Detection.[/*][*]Added Weather feature which can show the current weather conditions in the ring system and in the system tray.[/*][*]Added the "Fool Moon" achievement.  You can obtain this achievement by setting up your location in the Weather feature and witnessing a full moon on a clear night.[/*][*]Fixed bug with borderless full screen where the target application is positioned incorrectly sometimes when using multiple monitors.[/*][*]Added new achievements for opening the Action Search with a hotkey and for toggling the Ring Menu using a mouse button combination.  The default hotkey for Action Search is [Control]+[Shift]+[Tab] and the default combination for toggling the ring menu is [Middle Mouse Button]+[Right Mouse Button].  These two methods are how I (the developer) usually use the tool.[/*][*]Added Related Actions to achievements.  In the flyout window for each achievement, the action related to the achievement is shown.[/*][*]Fixed license message bug in achievement flyout windows.[/*][*]Added a link to the achievements feature in the welcome screen.[/*][*]Fixed achievement display ranges in Steam and one wrong achievement image.[/*] [/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.0.173 Released
notes.content:
9/22/2020 - Released Version 1.1.0.173

[list][*]Fixed an issue in the beta feature Settings Optimizer where the Disable Start Menu Web Search option had a typo which prevented it from working.[/*][*]Added an Overrides section to Chill Boost.  The minimum and maximum processor power state are now overridden by default to avoid confusion when the power state range of a user's base power plan does not allow Chill Boost to operate.  The override can be disabled so that Chill Boost will stay within the range of the base power scheme like before.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with Chill Boost Automatic Calibration where the standard operation of Chill Boost was interfering with auto calibration results.[/*][*]Improved Chill Boost Automatic Calibration to detect and remove bad data.  This increases the chances of successfully calibrating on some devices that previously would not fully complete the calibration process.  The new strategy requires more test runs, but for devices that were already working well, the speed can now be be turned up much higher without issue.[/*][*]Included Auto Start and Launch Menu Ring on Start options to the Welcome flyout to make it easier for new users to find them.[/*][*]Added an option to temporarily disable a free trial period.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with inter process communication.  This issue was causing the Microphone Manager user interface to sometimes fail, and may have been causing other strange behaviors in features that use separate processes.[/*][*]When closing the ring menu in the taskbar, now the ring menu will close and a notification will be shown with additional options for accessing the ring menu settings or closing the entire tool.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.0.119 Released
notes.content:
9/17/2020 - Released Version 1.1.0.119

[list][*]Finally available on Steam![/*][*]Fixed an issue where tiling and tabbing would sometimes stop working when restoring a maximized window group.[/*][*]Further improvements to topmost window contention.[/*][*]Fixed issue where virtual touch click engage threshold setting was not working and changed it to be a multiplier with 1 as the default.[/*][*]Fixed issue where virtual touch click disengage threshold setting was not working and changed it to be a multiplier with 1 as the default.[/*][*]Fixed issue where custom ring menu drag movement was not working correctly with touch screen events.[/*][*]Enabled Steam integration.[/*][*]Fixed bug preventing the Simplode Protocol feature from working.  This will allow shortcuts to individual features to work.[/*][*]When asking if you want to close existing instances of Simplode Suite during startup, the cancel option has been added, which will abort creating the new instance.[/*][/list]
